scope: Check existing files only; no R305 mechanism change or model export. Eight planned LPs, up to four anomaly-directed LPs reserved.

strain.name: PO1f
strain.assay_background: Cas9/Cas12a fitness screen with intact NHEJ; LEU2-marked sgRNA plasmid selected in SD-Leu

operations.protein_function: orotidine-5'-phosphate decarboxylase; de novo UMP biosynthesis
operations.evidence_status: PO1f genotype is directly reported; enzyme identity is curated; current GEM lacks this gene and R612 has no GPR

operations.complement_source: pCas9yl-GW/pLbCas12ayl-GW library plasmid backbone carrying the LEU2 selectable marker
operations.evidence_status: PO1f genotype, pCRISPRyl LEU2 marker, derivative library-vector construction, and SD-Leu selection are directly reported

provenance_only_variants: xpr2-322 and axp-2 are recorded but have no current small-molecule GEM reaction
Cas9/Cas12a expression cassettes integrated at A08 are assay provenance only
KU70 is intact in the fitness screen; delta-KU70 strains were used only for guide cutting-score calibration

R305_chemistry.name: ubiquinol-9:cytochrome-c reductase (complex III)

notes.coq9_curation_scope: Current GPR includes a cytochrome-c carrier dependency; native subunit-only AND membership is not certified.
notes.coq9_proton_state: Original audited proton stoichiometry retained; Q-cycle candidate not applied.

R305_chemistry.documented_qcycle_scope: Q-cycle mechanism candidate; existing cytosolic H is a P-side/intermembrane proxy, not a new compartment. No native stoichiometric measurement is claimed. Full GPR and bounds retained.
